subject: Can the variables in INLA-SPDE be categorical?

messages.subject: Can the variables in INLA-SPDE be categorical?
parts:
Hi there,

I have three questions about the INLA-SPDE model:
(1) Can the response variable be a binary variable?
(2) Can the covariates be categorical variables?
(3) If multicollinearity exists among the covariates, whether the response variable obtained will be unreliable?

Thank you.

Jian
